resources.string: Maintenance Mode is a technician workspace for BMS configuration and calibration. Unlock it before use.

Maintenance operations can affect battery protection, calibration, and behavior values. Proceed only if you understand the meaning and impact of the values. Incorrect settings can create unsafe conditions for the battery and equipment.
Write and calibration features will be delivered incrementally in later updates.
